title: The Morning Digest: October 5, 2026
dek: OPEC+ held November targets steady on Sunday and crude faded on the overnight tape (WTI ~$89.69, Brent ~$101.67) while heating oil rose 1.4%, pushing the diesel crack back above $100 on the session print. ING marked the ICE gasoil crack $85 to $70. TMW Nov26 held -$24.13 (ICE, Oct 2) with December at -$24.65 the widest tenor; Joliet is confirmed back in service; the SPR exchange bids are due Tuesday.
